text.en:
Only works while a <strand/>Strand Super is equipped.

Casting a Rift <strand/>Suspends all combatants within 6 meters. Killing <strand/>Suspended Enemies restores 15 HP.

Targets you <strand/>Suspend take ticks of damage every 0.467 seconds. Each damage tick restores 5 HP.

Damage over time starts at <pve 23 /> <pvp [9] /> damage, increasing by <pve ~5.5% /> <pvp [?%] /> per tick.

Enemies breaking free from <strand/>Suspension take an additional <pve 64 /> <pvp [34?] /> damage.

Targets <strand/>Suspended with a Rift cast take ~112.5% increased damage from the the above sources.
